cohort: Primiparous women in Burdur Province, Turkey, who gave birth in 2012
finding: Place of delivery (private or university hospital), time of birth, doctor's influence, and husband's employment status were identified as factors associated with cesarean delivery in primiparous women.
mod_finding: This study found that the location of delivery (private hospital or university hospital), time of birth, doctor's influence, and husband's employment status were factors associated with cesarean delivery in first-time mothers.
